title: Dash will not connect after updating phone to android 16
symptom: After updating phone to Android 16, the Omnipod Dash pod will not initialize or connect. Multiple pods failed to initialize or communicate after cannula insertion, and the user saw a 'failed to send basal' message.
cause: The thread suggests that Bluetooth pairing (bonding) must not be used with Android 16, and the user may have had pairing enabled after importing preferences.
fix: The maintainer states that pairing must not be used with Android 16 and provides a link to Bluetooth troubleshooting documentation. The user should disable Bluetooth pairing/bonding.
evidence_quote: pairing must not be used with android 16
